name: Signature
pose: He stands with weight shifted onto one leg, shoulders loose and ready, a confident, determined gaze toward the camera — a battle-ready stance, his expression wild and eager, a berserker's grin baring his teeth.
effects: A fine haze of dust drifts around his feet.

components.wearing: fitted Deep Rust Brown-toned banded leather armor across the chest and shoulders, Iron Grey stitching and buckles, arms left bare for freedom of movement, a reinforced belt and leg wraps; fur-trimmed pauldrons and a necklace of carved stone fetishes across the chest
components.companion: his bonded Dire Bear, a massive shaggy bear with claws like daggers, standing at his side

notes: First-pass minimal signature scene — reuses the striker-group default wardrobe set + the existing ancient-grove background (earthy fit).
